directory_policies.notes.6: Preparation: Advanced data structures and documented CS preparation must be declared explicitly. Functional programming is not treated as mandatory. MOOC completion alone does not establish prerequisite equivalency; the university reviews comparable preparation.
directory_policies.notes.7: English policy: CS MEng requires new TOEFL W4/L3.5/R4/S5.5; the department speaking threshold overrides the lower general table. IELTS 7 is accepted. Legacy TOEFL department thresholds, application-deadline validity and exact-cycle confirmation remain under review; meeting a score floor is not a full English pass. The 2.7 GPA stated for Cornell Early Admit is not applied to outside applicants.
